{{Color box|{{party color|Lakas–CMD}}|border=darkgray}} [[Lakas–CMD|Lakas]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Zambales's 2nd congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Zambales]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 10, 2021}} The district consists of the provincial capital [[Iba, Zambales|Iba]] and the rest of the municipalities north of the [[Subic Bay]] region, namely [[Botolan]], [[Cabangan]], [[Candelaria, Zambales|Candelaria]], [[Masinloc]], [[Palauig]], [[San Antonio, Zambales|San Antonio]], [[San Felipe, Zambales|San Felipe]], [[San Narciso, Zambales|San Narciso]] and [[Santa Cruz, Zambales|Santa Cruz]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 10, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Doris Maniquiz|Doris E. Maniquiz]] of the [[Sulong Zambales Party]] (SZP) and [[Lakas–CMD]] (Lakas).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 10, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
